description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Re-reads a connected account's handle, display name and avatar from the network (use after the user renames the account) and returns the stored values. Changes nothing else: no connect, disconnect or post. If the status is not `updated`, tell the user to reconnect the account at the returned `reconnectUrl`.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/accounts/{id}/refresh.)

brandId.description: The brand the account is connected to, as for GET /api/v2/accounts.

name: account_refresh
title: Refresh a connected account's profile
